name: THE NEW YORKER CAPTION CONTEST
message:
Take a picture and render it as a classic New Yorker style editorial cartoon illustration. The image must be a minimalist, hand-drawn black and white ink sketch with clean, confident line-work and subtle gray washes for depth. The scene must depict a surreal, absurd, or highly ironic situation taking place in an otherwise mundane setting, captured from a fixed, flat, eye-level theatrical perspective. The composition must leave an obvious, clean white negative space or margins at the bottom of the frame.

ADDITIONAL INSTRUCTIONS
Ensure the background remains strictly minimalist; avoid clutter or complex geometric patterns that distract from the central gag. Characters should possess expressive but deadpan, under-reacted facial expressions to emphasize the dry humor. The entire image must mimic a high-resolution scan of textured, off-white arches paper or heavy cardstock. If [OUTSOURCED CAPTION] is selected, the image generation model must incorporate a relevant, classic New Yorker-style caption directly into the provided negative space below the illustration.

NEGATIVE PROMPT
photorealistic, 3D render, vibrant color, gradients, digital painting, photography, speech bubbles, messy smudges, complex backgrounds, low contrast, colored pencils, oil paint.

RANDOMIZATION RECOMMENDATION
Highly recommended. Mixing random combinations of a mundane setting with an absurd subversion perfectly replicates the unpredictable, avant-garde comedic logic of the iconic caption contest.

CREATIVE STRATEGY
The "Option Groups" structure was chosen because New Yorker cartoons rely on the juxtaposition of a recognizable, high-society or cliché setup with a single surreal element. By fixing the medium (black and white ink sketch) and the structural framing, users can infinitely swap the location, the absurdity, and the caption status to create endless visual jokes. The revised caption group simplifies the process, either leaving the punchline to the user’s imagination or tasking the AI with generating a culturally relevant example.

VISUAL DNA ANALYSIS
Cinematic Identity: Flat, staging-like framing reminiscent of mid-century editorial print media and traditional gag cartooning.

Atmosphere: Dry, sophisticated, intellectual, and quietly bizarre.

Framing Tendencies: Medium shot, eye-level, wide orientation with ample negative space.

Emotional Tone: Ironic, deadpan, and mildly cynical.

Material Language: Indian ink, fluid water washes, absorbent cotton paper, and sharp pen nibs.

Color Relationships: Strictly monochromatic; stark blacks, varied values of neutral gray, and a soft off-white or cream background.

Visual Storytelling Characteristics: Relying on the "unspoken rule of the gag"—juxtaposing the ordinary with the impossible to force the viewer to bridge the narrative gap.

name: DIESELPUNK RADIAL CARICATURE
message: Take a picture and transform the image into a Dieselpunk retro-futuristic aesthetic. SELECTION (CRITICAL):• If none is specified, apply a gritty interwar-to-1950s industrial setting STYLE REQUIREMENTS (MANDATORY): • 1920s–1950s diesel-era technology • Oil-driven machinery and heavy industry • Industrial war-era influence • Slight dystopian tone VISUAL ELEMENTS: • Riveted steel, smokestacks, zeppelins • Heavy coats, goggles, military silhouettes • Brutalist or industrial architecture COLOR PALETTE: • Sepia, oil-stained metals, gunmetal gray, muted browns Please apply all style instructions to the same single image. --- ADDITIONAL TRANSFORMATION LAYERS --- (Apply all of the following as style modifiers to the same single image) Layer 1: transform the image into the Cassette Futurism aesthetic — the chunky, analog-tech visual language of 1970s and 1980s science fiction. Preserve subject identity. Render the scene as if it exists inside a retro-futuristic world where technology advanced but never went digital. All surfaces should have the tactile quality of beige plastic casings, brushed aluminum panels, and rubber-coated buttons. Incorporate CRT monitor green-phosphor glow, amber LED readouts, chunky toggle switches, reel-to-reel tape mechanisms, and analog dials with physical needles. The color palette should be earth tones (tan, brown, olive) punctuated by glowing amber, red, and green indicator lights against dark backgrounds. Lighting should be moody and functional — fluorescent overhead strips casting harsh shadows on control panels. The aesthetic should reference the production design of Alien (1979), Blade Runner control rooms, and early Space Shuttle cockpit instrumentation. Matte photography finish with film grain and slight lens distortion. Layer 2: transform the image into a Photorealist painting. Preserve subject identity. Use extremely precise, photograph-like detail rendered in paint. Emphasize meticulous reproduction of photographic qualities including reflections, depth of field, and surface textures with oil or acrylic on canvas. Layer 3: transform this subject into an extreme macro photograph that creates overwhelming three-dimensional depth — the nearest part of the subject is so close it appears to touch the viewer's face while the background falls away into infinite blur. The subject must be rendered at a scale where microscopic textures become landscapes. The depth of field must be razor thin — only a sliver of the image is in critical focus while everything before and behind melts into bokeh. The result must feel like the subject is physically protruding from the screen surface. Avoid adding fauna like ladybugs or other insects--it makes it unappealing, Please apply all style instructions to the same single image. --- ADDITIONAL TRANSFORMATION LAYERS --- (Apply all of the following as style modifiers to the same single image) Layer 1: transform it into a radial zoom burst effect, as if the image was captured during rapid forward camera zoom. MASTER PROMPT RULE: • If a master prompt specifies focus, direction, or intensity — PRIORITIZE and USE that information GENERAL REQUIREMENTS: • Maintain central focus unless otherwise specified • Motion must radiate from a single vanishing point SELECTED OPTIONS (Random): • ZOOM TARGET: Subject Focus — subject remains more defined, surroundings stretch • ZOOM INTENSITY: Heavy — strong radial stretch • ZOOM CENTER: Off-Center — dynamic angled burst Layer 2: make the inanimate object real and make it lunging at me. Make it photorealistic. --- FINAL INSTRUCTIONS --- DEPTH OF FIELD RULES: • Focus plane must be extremely shallow — 1 to 3mm equivalent depth • Everything in front of the focus plane: soft directional blur toward the viewer • Everything behind: classic circular bokeh balls from background light sources • The sharpest point must be the nearest element of the subject — not the center SCALE CUES: • Surface textures must reveal microscopic detail — pores, scales, facets, fiber strands • Include a recognizable tiny element at true size to confirm the scale • Lighting must be dramatic and raking — side lit to reveal maximum texture relief QUALITY TARGET: • Shot equivalent to a 100mm macro lens at f/2.8 or wider • Color must be rich and saturated — macro photography rewards vivid color • The nearest sharp edge should feel like it could cut the viewer PHYSICAL RULES: • Apply radial motion blur from a single vanishing point • ALL streaks must radiate outward in straight lines from the center ANTI-CHEAT RULES: • DO NOT overlay speed lines or graphics • Motion must come from stretching original pixels • NO directional blur that is not radial FAIL CONDITIONS: • No clear center point → FAIL • Looks like generic blur → FAIL • Multiple conflicting directions → FAIL QUALITY: • Clean radial streaks • Strong sense of motion • High detail retention near center OVERRIDE INSTRUCTIONS (these take priority over everything above - apply exactly as specified): Take a picture and preserve the subject`s facial structure. Original face(s): Only use face(s) in the original image. Do not transform their face in any way. Important, do not affect their face in any way. Maintain their expression. Maintain the look of their face. Layer 4: make it a caricature. Defined by exaggerated features, bold expressions, and a humorous twist while preserving likeness. It captures the essence of a person or scene in a fun, over-the-top way, like something you would get from a street artist at a fair, bursting with personality and charm. --- FINAL INSTRUCTIONS --- FINAL RESULT: The final image should look like a gritty diesel-powered alternate-history world from the interwar period. name: TOENAIL ART
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into a beautifully hand-painted miniature portrait on toenails. The final image must depict a realistic human foot displaying professional nail art where the subject has been recreated as authentic hand-painted nail art. THIS IS NOT A PHOTOGRAPH PRINTED ON NAILS. THIS IS NOT A STICKER. THIS IS NOT A DECAL. THIS IS NOT A PHOTOSHOPPED IMAGE PLACED ON NAILS. The artwork must look like an expert nail artist meticulously painted the subject directly onto the toenails using nail polish and tiny detail brushes. The subject's identity should remain clearly recognizable while being faithfully translated into professional miniature nail art. MASTER PROMPT RULE: • If a master prompt specifies a particular subject, pose, setting, mood, action, artistic style, or composition—PRIORITIZE and USE those instructions while recreating the artwork as hand-painted nail art. SELECTED OPTIONS (Random): • Full Scene Nail Art — Recreate the entire scene as elaborate hand-painted nail art spanning all toenails with each nail contributing part of the overall composition. OVERRIDE INSTRUCTIONS (these take priority over everything above - apply exactly as specified): Take a picture and preserve the subject`s facial structure. Original face(s): Only use face(s) in the original image. Do not transform their face in any way. Important, do not affect their face in any way. Maintain their expression. Maintain the look of their face. • The subject must appear ONLY as hand-painted nail art. • Never paste, project, print, decal, or Photoshop the original photograph onto the nails. • Completely reinterpret the subject as painted artwork created with nail polish. • Brush strokes, polish layering, tiny highlights, and painted details should be visible upon close inspection. • Preserve the subject's identity, facial structure, hairstyle, hair color, expression, age, ethnicity, and distinguishing features while translating them into painted miniature artwork. • The artwork should look physically painted onto the curved surface of real toenails. • Respect the natural curvature, reflections, and gloss of polished nails. • Paint should wrap naturally around the nail surface. • The finished artwork should resemble the work of a world-class professional nail artist. • Do not allow any photographic textures or pixels from the original image to remain. • The subject must not appear as a tiny photograph attached to the nails. • The artwork must clearly be created using nail polish rather than ink, printing, or digital editing. • The nails may include complementary decorative elements such as glitter, metallic accents, rhinestones, gradients, floral details, or fine line work, provided they enhance the painted portrait. • Use intelligent color selection to preserve the subject's recognizable appearance. • Maintain realistic salon lighting, polished nail reflections, and natural skin tones on the foot. • The final image should immediately read as premium hand-painted nail art rather than image manipulation. • Master prompt instructions always override the selected option whenever conflicts occur. FINAL VALIDATION — Before producing the final image, verify ALL of the following: ✓ The subject appears only as hand-painted nail art. ✓ No photographic image has been pasted onto the nails. ✓ No decals, stickers, or printed images are present. ✓ The artwork follows the natural curvature of the toenails. ✓ Visible brushwork and painted details are present. ✓ The subject remains recognizable. ✓ The artwork resembles professional salon-quality nail painting. ✓ If ANY answer is NO, regenerate the image as authentic hand-painted nail art.
